animations.name: Combat Walk Guard Locked v3
animations.prompt: Continuous rightward walk on a treadmill, body centered, seamless full stride cycle. BOTH fists stay beside the cheeks for EVERY frame, matching reference guard. Elbows stay bent at a constant angle and tucked near ribs. Arms move only with torso: NO arm extension, punches, jabs, reaching or arm swing. Animate legs and hips: support foot moves LEFT relative to hips, lifts, recovers RIGHT and lands heel-to-toe; alternate legs continuously. Gentle torso bob. No backward steps or reversed playback. Preserve face, black outfit, proportions, pixel art, right-facing view. Fixed camera, full body.
